offline_truth_diagnostic.source: saved original evaluation_manifest scene index7 obstacle0

supported_findings: Obstacle-adjacent cell581 was already occupied at initialization. Step24 is the first relevant current-segment blocking event for cell573, not the first observation of the entire physical obstacle.

Cell573 becomes occupied at step24 (p0.924142), causing current-position and remaining-path rejection and UNVERIFIED_BRAKING; it remains occupied through step66 then is classified free at step67 (p0.161109).

Cell565 remains occupied after cell573 clears. Its probability falls from0.710950 atstep77 to0.512498 atstep78; occupied becomes unknown, all remaining-path checks pass, and hold releases with SAFE. No new safe route is required for this release.
Cell565 becomes free atstep80 (p0.161109), unknown atstep81 (p0.310026), then occupied atstep82 (p0.851953), causing a second UNVERIFIED_BRAKING.

The underlying tracking waypoint lies in cell572, classified free since step12 and never occupied in this replay. Offline truth shows this waypoint is inside the obstacle; known-free voxel classification does not guarantee geometric clearance at the waypoint.

Step82 braking begins while downward velocity is-0.333974 and physical top clearance is0.061510m. Step83 speed decreases but top clearance is0.009998m, followed by swept collision atstep84. Braking reacts to the current known map yet does not stop in available distance.
The 54-step moving-position hold drifts1.734799m; this is observed movement, not a successful fixed-position stop.

mechanism_attribution.established: Previously occupied public voxels revert to unknown/free, releasing the old route; reclassification as occupied triggers braking with insufficient remaining physical clearance.
mechanism_attribution.source_supported_inference: integrate_obstacle_scan adds capped free and occupied ray evidence to the same coarse voxel log-odds; free rays and hit endpoints can compete within a partially occupied voxel. public_geometry permits unknown voxels and has no memory of previous occupied states. The observed flips are consistent with this mechanism.
not_established: Individual free/hit ray counts and their agent attribution were not logged; exact rays responsible cannot be identified.
A counterfactual repair or Found improvement has not been tested.
This one paired case does not establish the frequency of this failure mode over the full20-scene population.

candidate_followup_ablations.name: chapter3_public_obstacle_memory
candidate_followup_ablations.change: Retain previously occupied cells in a search-only safety overlay until a separately specified robust release condition is met; use public evidence only.
candidate_followup_ablations.isolation: Keep core mapping, physical obstacles, task and reward unchanged; compare false holds and recovery as well as collision.

candidate_followup_ablations.name: braking_distance_and_release_hysteresis

candidate_followup_ablations.isolation: Use public position/velocity and calibrated existing dynamics; no direct velocity reset.
